id: # OpenProcessor local VLM catalog: what the in-compose vLLM can serve.
# One file, two readers: scripts/lib/vlm_catalog.sh (installer + CLI, which
# PICK) and src/services/labeling/vlm_catalog.py (the API, which only
# displays and computes `fits`). Tab-separated; the first non-comment line
# is the header; '#' lines are comments. New columns are only ever
# appended, so the bash readers' column numbers stay valid.
# vram_gb: gemma-4-e4b is measured (~23 GB total at
# --gpu-memory-utilization 0.4 on a 48 GB card); every other value is an
# estimate (weights + ~6 GB KV/activations at 8192 + ~3 GB CUDA
# overhead) until it is measured and its status becomes `tested`.
# multi_box_verified / text_reading_verified: `unknown` = not checked yet,
# `true` = a live check passed for that entry. (Always a value, never an
# empty last column: the repo's whitespace hook strips a trailing tab.)
# Checked and EXCLUDED: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct (qwen-research
# licence, non-commercial); Gemma 3 (google/gemma-3-4b-it, -12b-it: Gemma
# terms, gated with manual approval; Gemma 4 replaces it under Apache-2.0).
